layout.description: For older watch builds: the nearest old layout, kept in step with the fields below.

secondClock.description: What the second clock shows (UI-22); down is the time left. Never the same as mainClock.

clocks.description: Missing in setups saved before the four choices (UI-21): worked out from layout.

mainClock.description: How the match clock counts (TMR-11); up (Match time) when missing.

breakClock.description: How the break clock counts (TMR-4); down when missing.

edge.description: Missing in older setups: worked out from layout.

names.description: The team names over the clock, or false for scores only. Missing in older setups: worked out from layout.

changedAt.description: When it was last changed, wherever that was: the latest change wins (UI-24).

description: How the watch's running screen looks, for all the account's watches (UI-21, UI-24).
